meta.title: Creators
meta.description: The streamers, editors and competitors of Gamer's Exile. Collabs, raid trains, clip support and honest feedback for creators at every stage.

header.title: A Launchpad, Not a Leaderboard
header.lead: Streamers, editors and competitors building something of their own — supported by a community that shows up to watch, chat and grow with them.

roster.title: Who You'll Find Here
roster.lead: Filter by what they do. Everyone on this list started somewhere, and most of them started here.
roster.leadEmpty: The roster is being put together. The first streamers, creators and players will be announced here and in the Discord.

filters.empty: No creators in this category yet.

card.placeholderBody: The roster is being put together. Stream or make content? Take the creator role in the Discord to be considered.

perks.title: Support That Is Actually Support
perks.lead: No exclusivity clauses, no revenue cut, no follower minimum. Four things we do for every creator in the server.

collabs.title: Collabs & Raid Trains
collabs.body: Scheduled raid trains every week and a collab board where members pair up for co-streams, tournaments and challenge runs.

chat.title: A Chat That Shows Up
chat.body: Go-live pings that people actually answer. New streamers get their first real audience here instead of talking to an empty room.

clips.title: Clips & Shoutouts
clips.body: Your best moments get cut, posted and pushed across the community's channels. Good clips travel further than good luck.

feedback.title: Feedback, Not Flattery
feedback.body: Honest reviews of your overlay, audio, pacing and thumbnails from people who have already made the mistakes you are about to.

cta.heading: Want to Be on the Roster?
cta.lead: Join the Discord and take the creator role. Post your channel in the creators channel and you're on the raid train rotation the same week.
